label: <DEL> step when the sequence starts with 3/r/o/p/z/x/f/t/s (first output prep)
explanation: Almost entirely a delimiter-step unit: 89% of activation mass is at the <DEL> step (recall_idx 0), where the model has to emit the first original token. It never fires in the copy phase. Which delimiter steps fire depends on the first original token: rate is highest when it is 3 (4.2x lift), then r, o, p, z, and lower for x, f, t, s. It also climbs with sequence length (none at L=3, highest at L=8-9). A second token from the same set helps for shorter sequences. The other 11% is weak pre-firing at the last 1-2 original steps of long sequences (L>=8) that have a favored first token. It looks like a graded readout of first-token identity plus length, so a boolean predicate catches most of the mass but has only moderate precision. Many <DEL> steps with a favored first token stay below threshold.
